items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: we had a tour with Gypsy -- Jane Foreman, was it Gypsy Rose Lee or Gypsy Markoff or something, one of those names.

ctx.x: Okay. Remember any other anecdotes about the Basie band, any other incidents that --

Let's see. Let me think. Oh, I remember one time, we were -- this was before the band had ever gone to Europe, it was around 1943, and we had a tour with Gypsy -- Jane Foreman, was it Gypsy Rose Lee or Gypsy Markoff or something, one of those names. I can't remember now. But we had a long tour in Europe and we were going to end up coming around through Portugal, went back to New York, and we wanted

to go, you know, we'd never been there. So all of a sudden -- we'd gotten all ready shot-wise and everything, Basie said, "I'm not going." So we says, "What are you talking about?" We thought he was kidding at first. So he said, "No, I'm serious. I'm really not going." So we said, "Well, man, we ain't never been to Europe. Why don't you want to go to Europe?" He says, "Well, --" Somebody -- he had a feeling, fortune-teller or something told him not to go. She said, "I see danger in this trip." And he was a little…
